shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: They represent rear edges of the folded three-dimensional bowl that are hidden from view. Right image: It is an auxiliary chord-like reference segment within the plane circle diagram.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashed AD segment is a planar reference across a circle, not the occluded boundary of a solid. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
